description: This is a PHP source file for configuring wireless network settings through a web interface. It includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP code to display and manage Wi-Fi configurations such as SSID, security modes, channels, and passwords, with embedded logic for user interactions and AJAX updates.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Fetches specific Wi-Fi configuration parameters by calling an external function and processes the returned data into an associative array.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration object, and sends it via AJAX to update Wi-Fi settings on the device.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends a reset/restore command via AJAX to revert Wi-Fi settings to defaults.
